title: Berth Times
pitch: Zeke ties up boats on Pier Nine and sells Victor's berth times to the Varga crew. Collect what they paid him.

clue_a.label: Container thirty-one
lines: Chalk inside container thirty-one. Victor's berth times for the month, copied out neatly. Zeke's tidy hand.

clue_b.label: The quay ladder
lines: A phone in a plastic bag, tied under the quay ladder. One number saved. Not one of Victor's.
